items.title: SF Ruby Startup Conference 2026 (Nov 10-12 in San Francisco)
items.blurb: A conference for engineers who read and write Ruby. November 10-12, 2026 at SFJAZZ: agentic Rails in production, and networking where everyone gets the mic.

items.title: written a post about why you should go
items.blurb: The SF Ruby Startup Conference is an engineers' conference: meet the people building Ruby open source, scaling Rails in production, and shaping what agentic Rails looks like next.
